products.source: BOB-LIFT Marine Crane Product Manual, PDF page 6

features.title: High-strength steel structure
features.text: The main structure utilizes high-strength steel plates, resulting in a compact, lighter, stronger, and more durable design.

features.title: Dedicated torque limiter
features.text: Equipped with a dedicated torque limiter for elevated safety standards; certified by multiple safety authorities to ensure precise, secure, and reliable lifting operations.

features.title: Custom installation
features.text: Customizable installation methods tailored to specific operational scenarios.

features.title: Optional attachments
features.text: Multiple optional configurations, including winches, drill pipes, aerial baskets, and grapples, accommodate personalized customization needs.

features.title: Operation modes
features.text: Multiple operation modes available, including overhead seat and wireless remote control systems, for enhanced operational convenience.

features.title: Dual four-bar linkage
features.text: Dual four-bar linkage boom mechanism enables reverse angle operation, offering broad applicability and flexible performance.
